name: Fire Extinguishers
intro: Protect your property and lives with APEX FIRE SAFETY's portable and trolley-mounted fire extinguishers. Certified for fire classes A, B, C, D and K, and suitable for residential, commercial and industrial use.

items.name: AFFF Fire Extinguishers
items.desc: Foam extinguisher for fuel stations, warehouses, factories, airports and commercial buildings.
details: Sizes: 6 L, 9 L portable · 25 L, 50 L trolley
Prices vary with certification (CE / EN3 / ISO) and quantity
Not for live electrical equipment or deep-fat fryers

items.name: CO2 Fire Extinguishers
items.desc: For electrical panels, servers, IT equipment and flammable liquid fires. Leaves no residue.
details: Sizes: 2 kg, 3 kg, 5 kg portable · 9 kg, 22.5 kg, 45 kg trolley
Not effective on deep-seated Class A fires

items.name: DCP Fire Extinguisher
items.desc: Multi-purpose dry chemical powder (monoammonium phosphate) for plants, warehouses, offices, commercial buildings and vehicles.
details: Fire classes: A, B and C
Not for servers, commercial kitchens (Class F) or combustible metals (Class D)

items.name: Halotron Fire Extinguishers
items.desc: Clean agent extinguisher for data centers, labs, server rooms, museums, hangars and hospitals. Non-conductive, no residue.
details: Fire classes: A, B and C

items.name: Water Fire Extinguishers
items.desc: Cost-effective, eco-friendly Class A extinguisher for offices, schools, warehouses and homes.
details: Sizes: 6 L, 9 L portable · 45 L, 50 L trolley
Not for live electrical, flammable liquid or cooking oil fires

items.name: Wet Chemical Fire Extinguishers
items.desc: Potassium-based solution for commercial kitchens, restaurants, cafeterias and food processing units.
details: Not for Class B flammable liquid fires

name: Industrial Safety
intro: Our industrial safety range of PPE, fire-resistant gear and emergency tools is built to protect workers in high-risk environments.

items.name: Fire Fighting Pumps
items.desc: Automatic pump sets (electric main, diesel backup and jockey pump) supplying water to sprinkler, hydrant, hose reel and deluge systems.
details: Materials: cast iron or stainless steel

items.name: Fire Hose Nozzles
items.desc: Attaches to the end of a fire hose to control and direct water flow.
details: Types: jet (smooth bore), fog, adjustable/combination, automatic pressure-balancing
Fits canvas hoses, rubberized fire hoses and landing valves

items.name: Fire Hose Pipe
items.desc: Flexible, high-pressure hose delivering water or foam for firefighting.
details: Types: lay-flat, rubber, double-jacket and suction
Available in various lengths and diameters

items.name: Fire Hose Reel Cabinet
items.desc: Protective enclosure that keeps hose reels ready for emergencies.
details: Indoor or outdoor use, corrosion and weather resistant
Locking system with quick emergency access
Red powder-coated, stainless steel or custom colors

items.name: Fire Hydrant Valve
items.desc: Heavy-duty landing valve controlling high-pressure water flow on risers, hose cabinets and hydrants.
details: Single-unit and bulk pricing with nationwide delivery

items.name: Pillar Fire Hydrant
items.desc: Above-ground hydrant for perimeter fire mains and industrial sites.
details: Type: wet barrel or dry barrel

items.name: Fire Exit Doors
items.desc: Passive fire protection that contains fire and gives occupants time to escape.
details: Door leaf: 63 mm thick, 0.80 mm galvanised steel
Powder coated, standard RAL 9002 or custom RAL colors

items.name: FM 200 Fire Suppression
items.desc: Automatic clean-agent system for data centers, server rooms and critical facilities.
details: Safe for occupied spaces at design concentrations

items.name: Kitchen Fire Suppression System
items.desc: Automatic wet chemical system for commercial kitchen hoods, restaurants, hotels and food processing.
details: Cylinder sizes: 1.5, 3.0 and 6.0 gallon stainless steel
Automatic thermal release plus manual pull station
Gas shut-off and electrical breaker trip interlocks

items.name: Water Fire Suppression Systems
items.desc: Automatic water-based suppression for commercial, industrial and high-rise buildings.
details: Systems: sprinkler, water mist, deluge, pre-action
Standards: NFPA 13, NFPA 750, UL Listed, FM Approved

items.name: Smoke & Heat Detectors (Conventional Fire Alarm Systems)
items.desc: Optical smoke and fixed-temperature heat sensors that give early fire warning. Suited to bedrooms, kitchens and garages.

items.name: Conventional Fire Alarm Panels
items.desc: Zoned panels with radial wiring for basic monitoring at small sites, with 2–32 zones and battery backup.

items.name: Addressable Fire Alarm Systems
items.desc: Loop-wired networks for large facilities, where each device has a unique ID for precise location.

items.name: Fire Alarm Bells & Sounders
items.desc: Wall- or ceiling-mounted audible alerts for evacuation, with weatherproof options.

items.name: Horn / Strobe Flashers
items.desc: Combined audible and visual units for inclusive alerts, including for hearing-impaired users.

items.name: Manual Call Points
items.desc: Resettable break-glass stations that trigger alarms manually, rated weatherproof IP67.

items.name: UL Listed Conventional Optical Smoke Detector
Fire Protective Clothing & Accessories
items.desc: Layered Nomex or Kevlar ensembles with hoods and gloves for emergency responders. Thermal barriers, reflective trim and moisture-wicking.

items.name: Breathing Apparatus & Gas Masks
items.desc: Self-contained SCBA sets with 30–60 minute air cylinders for toxic smoke, confined spaces and chemical fires. HUD displays, quick-connect masks and harness straps.

items.name: Fire Safety Gloves
items.desc: Heat-resistant gloves with flame-retardant lining and reinforced grip for firefighting, industrial handling and rescue.

items.name: Industrial & Personal Protective Equipment
items.desc: Full-body suits, helmets and gloves for hazard zones such as factories and oil rigs. Flame-retardant fabrics and multi-hazard ratings.

items.name: VHD Dome Camera
items.desc: Compact indoor dome with HD monitoring, low-light performance and a vandal-resistant casing.

items.name: HD Bullet Camera
items.desc: Long-range outdoor HD camera with infrared night vision and an IP66 weatherproof housing.

items.name: Wireless Wi-Fi Camera
items.desc: Cable-free HD camera with motion alerts, two-way audio and remote access through mobile apps.

items.name: PTZ Security Camera
items.desc: Pan, tilt and zoom camera for wide-area monitoring, with optical zoom and remote control.

items.name: 4K Ultra HD Camera
items.desc: 4K camera with wide dynamic range, color night vision and smart motion detection.

items.name: Mini Indoor Camera
items.desc: Small HD indoor camera with motion alerts, two-way audio and mobile app access.

items.name: Solar Powered Camera
items.desc: Solar-charged outdoor camera with battery backup and wireless connectivity for remote sites.

items.name: Smart Doorbell Camera
items.desc: HD doorbell camera with two-way audio, night vision and mobile notifications.

items.name: Emergency Lighting & Safety Signs
items.desc: Battery-backed LED guides with photoluminescent backups for low-visibility escape. 3-hour runtime, exit arrow signage and self-testing.
